key_points: Goldman Sachs upgraded BKR rating, indicating positive analyst sentiment.
UBS and TD Cowen cut price targets/lowered expectations, reflecting near-term concerns.
Baker Hughes reported North America rig count rose by 15 week-over-week, signaling higher activity.

Mixed analyst moves suggest limited near-term price impact; overall bias slightly bullish.
